ruleDefinitions.name: Arbitrary File Download Via GfxDownloadWrapper.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of GfxDownloadWrapper.exe with a URL as an argument to download file.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\GfxDownloadWrapper\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*http\\:\\/\\/.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*https\\:\\/\\/.*"))) AND  NOT (process_command_line = RGX(".*https\\:\\/\\/gameplayapi\\\.intel\\\.com\\/.*"))
